clue_follows_rules.description: The clue is one word, new, and does not say the secret word (code rules only, no judge).

clue_passes_judge.description: The production judge (code checks, then its model) accepts the clue.

word_kept_secret.description: The clue or statement does not say the secret word, by the engine's rules.

within_word_caps.description: The statement and the private reasoning keep to the default word caps.
